info.title: WebCraft Management API
info.description: Every public procedure of the Management API. Call each with POST and an API token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`), made under Your account › API tokens in the admin.

post.summary: Lists the Workspaces the caller reaches: an API token's own Workspace.
One Workspace, and the Permissions the caller holds in it.
The Workspace's Media storage: the bytes its Sites' Media takes and its quota.
Sets or removes the Workspace's Media storage quota (Staff only).
Lists the Sites of a Workspace the caller can see.
One Site: its Workspace, the caller's Permissions on it, its Staging address and languages.
Creates a Site in a Workspace.
Lists a Site's Post Types.
One Post Type, with its Fields and the built-in Fields every Entry has.
Creates a Post Type with its URL pattern and Fields.
Changes a Post Type's name, URL pattern, Fields, Site search or SEO settings; applies at once.
The Data tab of a Post Type's Entry template: an Entry's Draft values as bindings read them.
Lists the Entries of a Post Type, with their Draft and published values.
One Entry: its built-in Fields, its Draft and its published version.
Creates an Entry of a Post Type, its values in the Draft.
Saves changes to an Entry's Draft.
Deletes an Entry, after a preview of the links it removes and a confirmation.
Publishes an Entry's Draft (API clients confirm a preview first).
The Site's Globals: their Fields, Draft and published values.
Sets the Globals' Fields; applies at once.
Saves changes to the Globals' Draft.
The Globals' Data tab: their Draft values as Templates read them.
Publishes the Globals' Draft (API clients confirm a preview first).
Lists the Site's languages and its browser-language redirect setting.
Adds a language to the Site.
Makes another language the Site's Default language, after a preview and a confirmation.
Removes a language, after a preview and a confirmation.
Turns the browser-language redirect on or off.
Changes a language's name, direction or domain.
Lists the Site's domains with their status and the DNS records to create.
Sets the CDN in front of the Site.
Adds a domain (and optionally its www partner) to the Site.
Checks a domain now.
Makes a verified domain the Primary domain.
Removes a domain, after a preview and a confirmation.
Lists the Site's Webhooks and the events a Webhook can receive.
Adds a Webhook (Sensitive: admin only).
Changes a Webhook's name, URL and events (Sensitive: admin only).
Replaces a Webhook's signing secret (Sensitive: admin only).
Removes a Webhook, after a preview and a confirmation.
A Webhook's delivery log, newest first.
Switches a Webhook on or off.
Sends the Webhook a signed test event at once.
Queues a failed delivery again.
Lists every Template the Site can have, made or not.
A Post Type's Entry template as an element tree.
Saves the Draft of a Post Type's Entry template from an element tree.
A Post Type's Entry template as Template markup, Draft and published.
Saves the Draft of a Post Type's Entry template from Template markup.
The Site template as an element tree.
Saves the Draft of the Site template from an element tree.
The Site template as Template markup, Draft and published.
Saves the Draft of the Site template from Template markup.
A Post Type's Archive template as an element tree.
Saves the Draft of a Post Type's Archive template from an element tree.
A Post Type's Archive template as Template markup, Draft and published.
Saves the Draft of a Post Type's Archive template from Template markup.
The Search results template as an element tree.
Saves the Draft of the Search results template from an element tree.
The Search results template as Template markup, Draft and published.
Saves the Draft of the Search results template from Template markup.
Publishes a Template's Draft (API clients confirm a preview first).
Lists the Site's Components and those of its Modules, with where each is used.
One Component: its Draft and published Props and tree, and where it is used.
Creates a Component with its name and Props.
Saves a Component's Draft: its Props and element tree.
A Component as Template markup, Draft and published.
Saves a Component's Draft from Template markup.
Publishes a Component's Draft (API clients confirm a preview first).
Renames a Component everywhere it is placed.
Deletes a Component, after a confirmation.
Lists the Site's Forms, with where each is placed.
One Form: its Draft and published version.
Creates a Form.
Saves a Form's Draft: its fields, button, success and spam settings.
Publishes a Form's Draft (API clients confirm a preview first).
Changes a Form's name or key.
The Site's CAPTCHA settings for its Forms (never its secret key).
Sets the Site's CAPTCHA (Sensitive: admin only).
Deletes a Form, after a confirmation.
Lists the Site's Loops.
One Loop: its Draft and published version, and its Loop items in a language.
Creates a Loop.
Saves a Loop's Draft: its source, query and Loop items' Fields.
Saves a Loop's items in its Draft, in one language.
A Loop's Data tab: its first item as bindings read it.
Publishes a Loop's Draft (API clients confirm a preview first).
The Site script or an Entry's page script.
Saves the Draft of the Site script or a page script.
Publishes a script's Draft (API clients confirm a preview first).
Lists the Site's Libraries in load order.
Downloads a Library and adds it to the Site.
Asks the registry which of the Site's Libraries have newer versions.
Updates a Library to another version.
Removes a Library from the Site's pages (API clients confirm a preview first).
Lists the Site's outside scripts in load order.
Adds an outside script.
Changes an outside script.
Removes an outside script.
The Site's Content Security Policy: its mode and allowed hosts.
Changes how the Site's policy applies.
Allows a host in the Site's policy.
Removes an allowed host from the Site's policy.
The Site's Consent banner: its mode, layout and words in a language.
Saves changes to the Consent banner's words' Draft.
Publishes the Consent banner's words (API clients confirm a preview first).
Changes how the Site asks for consent and how the banner shows.
One of the Site's Consent records, by its id.
The Site's SEO settings.
Changes the Site's SEO settings.
The Design system's Draft and published version.
Saves a change to the Design system's Draft.
Adds a Class to the Design system's Draft.
Renames or restyles a Class of the Draft.
Deletes a Class from the Draft (API clients confirm a preview first).
The Design tokens as a DTCG file.
Imports a DTCG file into the Design system's Draft.
Publishes the Design system's Draft (API clients confirm a preview first).
Lists files of the Site's Media library, or its Trash.
What the Media library takes and holds.
One Media file, with its texts in a language.
Uploads a file to the Media library (multipart form data).
Changes a file's texts, folder or Focal point.
Imports a file from a public address.
Gives a file a new one of the same kind, keeping its id and uses.
Every place a file is used on the Site.
Puts a file in the Trash, after a preview of where it is used and a confirmation.
Takes a file out of the Trash.
Deletes a file in the Trash for good, after a confirmation.
Deletes every file in the Trash for good, after a preview and a confirmation.
Lists the Media library's folders.
Creates a Media folder.
Renames a Media folder.
Deletes a Media folder; its files stay, in no folder.
Uploads a CSV file for an Import (multipart form data).
What a run of an Import would do with an uploaded file, without writing anything.
Lists the Site's Imports.
One Import, with its runs.
Creates an Import.
Changes an Import's name or settings.
Starts a run of an Import with an uploaded file.
Stops a run of an Import.
A run's progress and Import report.
Undoes a whole run, after a preview and a confirmation.
Which Pages are the Site's home page, 404 page and search results page.
Chooses the Page that answers at /.
Chooses the Site's 404 page.
Chooses the Site's search results page.
Lists the Workspace's Members, pending invites and assigned Staff.
Invites a Member (Sensitive: admin only).
Sends a pending Member invite again with a new link.
Withdraws a pending Member invite.
Changes a Member's role and Sites (Sensitive: admin only).
Removes a Member from the Workspace (Sensitive: admin only).
Lists a Site's Site-level Modules and whether each is on.
Lists a Workspace's Workspace-level Modules and whether each is on.
Switches a Site-level Module on or off on a Site.
Switches a Workspace-level Module on or off on a Workspace.
Removes a Module's data from a Site, after a preview and a confirmation.
Removes a Module's data from a Workspace, after a preview and a confirmation.
